Perspective.title: Visitor Perspective
Perspective.description: A verified perspective or architectural note shared by a Google-authenticated visitor with a mandatory profile picture.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in author.

authorName.description: Display name shown alongside the perspective.

authorRole.description: Optional role, discipline, or context provided by the author.

photoUrl.description: Compulsory portrait URL or compressed base64 image identifying who shared the perspective.

message.description: The perspective or message shared for Chinaza Joseph.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded on initial creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp recorded on latest update.

/perspectives/{perspectiveId}.description: Publicly readable collection of verified visitor perspectives with mandatory photos and zero PII.
